article_title: Burnham brings forward ban on 'subscription traps' to ease cost of living

tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of the measures announced by Andy Burnham?
options: To replace online shopping with high-street stores
To protect consumers from subscription traps and misleading discounts while easing living costs
To raise the price of all long-term contracts
To prevent retailers from offering genuine sales
tasks.correct_answer: To protect consumers from subscription traps and misleading discounts while easing living costs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הצעדים נועדו להקל על יוקר המחיה באמצעות הגנה מפני מנויים שקשה לבטל ומבצעי מחיר מטעים.

tasks.prompt: Which practice is described as a “subscription trap”?
options: A retailer offering a genuine one-day discount
A customer paying cash for one purchase
A contract renewing automatically and being difficult to cancel
A shop closing during parliamentary recess
tasks.correct_answer: A contract renewing automatically and being difficult to cancel
tasks.explanation_hebrew: subscription trap הוא מצב שבו מנוי מתחדש, לעיתים במחיר גבוה יותר, והיציאה ממנו מסובכת או לא ברורה.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “outlaw” mean?
options: To advertise a discount widely
To consult retailers privately
To postpone a policy until spring
To make a practice illegal
tasks.explanation_hebrew: outlaw פירושו לאסור בחוק; הממשלה מתכננת לאסור שיטות תמחור מטעות.

tasks.prompt: What will the new subscription rules require from businesses?
options: Clearer information, reminders, easier cancellation and a cooling-off period
A permanent ban on every subscription service
Only annual contracts with no trial periods
Higher renewal prices displayed after payment
tasks.correct_answer: Clearer information, reminders, easier cancellation and a cooling-off period
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכללים כוללים מידע ברור מראש, תזכורות, יציאה פשוטה יותר וחלון ביטול של 14 יום לאחר ניסיון או חידוש.

tasks.prompt: Why can a fake “was” price mislead shoppers?
options: It hides the name of the product
It makes the current price look like a larger saving than it really is
It prevents a customer from using a subscription
It guarantees that every retailer loses money
tasks.correct_answer: It makes the current price look like a larger saving than it really is
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מחיר קודם מומצא או מנופח יוצר רושם שההנחה הנוכחית גדולה ואטרקטיבית יותר מהחיסכון האמיתי.

tasks.prompt: What does “crackdown” mean in the phrase “a crackdown on pretend prices”?
options: A new advertising campaign
A public opinion survey
Strong action to stop or punish the practice
A temporary discount offered by shops
tasks.correct_answer: Strong action to stop or punish the practice
tasks.explanation_hebrew: crackdown פירושו נקיטת צעדים תקיפים נגד תופעה; כאן הכוונה לאכיפה נגד מחירים מטעים.

tasks.prompt: Name two protections consumers should receive under the planned subscription changes.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי הגנות קונקרטיות המתוארות בכתבה.
expected_points: Clearer up-front information about the contract
Regular reminders before or during the subscription
A much easier way to cancel
A 14-day cooling-off period after a trial or long-term renewal

tasks.prompt: Summarise Burnham's consumer package and the debate around it in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את שתי קבוצות הצעדים, מטרת יוקר המחיה, לוח הזמנים ותגובה אחת לפחות.
expected_points: The government plans to tackle subscription traps and misleading pricing
Subscription rules will make contracts clearer and easier to leave
A consultation will consider banning fake previous prices and invented discounts
The measures are presented as practical cost-of-living savings
Consumer advocates welcomed action while critics questioned its originality or scale

tasks.prompt: Why might clearer information alone be insufficient unless cancellation is also made easier?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבדל בין ידיעת תנאי החוזה לבין היכולת המעשית לצאת ממנו.
expected_points: A consumer may understand a renewal but still face a complicated exit process
Automatic renewals can continue charging people who no longer want the service
Effective protection requires both informed consent and a simple cancellation route

tasks.prompt: Explain how the government could test whether the reforms genuinely reduce household costs.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע מדדים מעשיים הקשורים ישירות למנויים ולמבצעי מחיר, ולא להסתפק בהצהרה כללית.
expected_points: Track cancellation times and complaints before and after implementation
Measure how many unwanted renewals are prevented or reversed
Audit whether advertised previous prices are genuine
Estimate verified savings rather than relying only on government forecasts
